result_rules.Count/CountField/CountDistinctField: required int64, zero on empty; field counts ignore NULL
result_rules.Sum/Avg: exact inputs, including integers -> value.Nullable[decimal.Decimal]; numeric cast avoids integer overflow
result_rules.Min/Max: ordered stored fields -> nullable present input type, including already-nullable fields (one layer)
result_rules.summaries_empty_all_null: NULL; FILTER retains all empty-input rules

api.ordered_column_constraint: Sealed type-set capability over the eight framework ordered kinds, using their private kind fields as markers and the existing private ExpressionColumn method. Enum/scalar wrappers cannot reproduce that state. No new column methods, capability issuance or structural callbacks; NullableText remains within its 25-method guard.
api.nullable_aggregate_param: NullableOrderedAggregate[S,V].Param(v V) RowExpression[S,V]: present comparison codec and present required fallback, retaining ownership and errors. CoalesceValue(total.Value(),total.Param(v).Value()) returns required V.

relation_4d_reuse.interface: expr.AggregateExpression[S,V], implemented only by aggregate descriptors, retaining scope/result V
relation_4d_reuse.bridge: expr.FoundryAggregate returns native AggregateNode metadata with full ownership/error state plus typed bind/clone/scan closures
relation_4d_reuse.empty_result: zero V represents count=0, exists=false, nullable summary=NULL; loading state remains the relation slot owner responsibility
relation_4d_reuse.scoping: At constructors validate stored-column ownership through existing expr.At; filters and operands retain declaration/scope identities; native requalification stays in querycore
